#### **1. Who Said What (Sort by Date & Time)**

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Tuesday, August 20, 2024 8:26 AM:**
  - Provided updates on contract setup for Avicenna and consultancy.
  - Requested progress update on the phase 1 contract for Avicenna.
  - Mentioned Avicenna's readiness to start main development work pending contract finalization.
  - *Key quote:* "Avicenna have already set up the initial smartphone app and custom survey and provided training for me and Giulia on how to use their researchers’ platform."

- **[Jack Kneeshaw] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Wednesday, August 21, 2024 5:50 PM:**
  - Requested clarification on ownership of customizations and tax inclusion in the £5k payment.
  - *Key quote:* "All customisations to the app/platform/software paid for by us are owned by Avicenna (and made available to others via Apple and Google Play stores) but we have a free licence to use them. Is that right?"

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Monday, September 2, 2024 6:15 PM:**
  - Acknowledged delay in responding to Jack's questions.
  - Confirmed the £5k is inclusive of taxes.
  - Expressed urgency in finalizing the contract due to time constraints.
  - *Key quote:* "Can I ask what the issue with the initial contract is? Is there a way to speed this up as we’re running out of time?"

- **[Jack Kneeshaw] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Tuesday, September 3, 2024 3:46 PM:**
  - Informed Magda that he is chasing Procurement to expedite the contract process.
  - *Key quote:* "I'm chasing Procurement ... I am as keen as you to get this sorted asap!"

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Tuesday, September 3, 2024 3:52 PM:**
  - Apologized for lack of experience in setting up contracts and acknowledged the time it takes.
  - *Key quote:* "Apologies, I’ve not got experience with setting up contracts and haven’t realised how long it takes."

- **[Jack Kneeshaw] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Friday, September 6, 2024 1:31 PM:**
  - Asked if Avicenna has SaaS terms and conditions for annexing to the agreement.
  - *Key quote:* "Do Avicenna have a set of SaaS (Software as a Service) terms and conditions?"

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Friday, September 6, 2024 2:43 PM:**
  - Forwarded Sara's response regarding Avicenna's legal terms and potential updates due to ISO certification.
  - *Key quote:* "Additionally, please be aware that as we are working through our ISO certification, I have been informed that some parts of our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use may need to be updated to better reflect our internal operations."

- **[Jack Kneeshaw] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Monday, September 9, 2024 4:36 PM:**
  - Thanked Sara for clarifying terms and conditions.
  - Suggested that Avicenna's terms relate to individual users and not the University contract.
  - Requested Avicenna to fill in highlighted details in the attached contract.
  - *Key quote:* "I imagine that it will only be those individuals testing the customised app who are expected to agree to your terms and conditions."

- **[Magda Borkowska] (Role not specified, Essex University) – Monday, September 9, 2024 7:40 PM:**
  - Noted the need to change timelines for Custom Mobile Applications and Fitbit Clockface App due to delays.
  - Pointed out a typo in the study name.
  - Requested Sara to suggest new timelines for deliverables.
  - *Key quote:* "We will need to change the timeline for (1) Custom Mobile Applications (26-30 Aug.) and (2) Fitbit Clockface App (23-27 Sep.) as we’re delayed."

- **[August 20, 2024]:** Magda provided updates on contract setup and requested progress on Avicenna's phase 1 contract.

- **[September 2, 2024]:** Magda confirmed tax inclusion and expressed urgency in finalizing the contract.
- **[September 3, 2024]:** Jack chased Procurement; Magda acknowledged contract setup delays.
- **[September 6, 2024]:** Jack inquired about SaaS terms; Magda relayed Sara's response on legal terms.
- **[September 9, 2024]:** Jack thanked Sara for terms clarification; Magda requested new timelines due to delays.

- **Timeline Adjustments:** Delays necessitate changes to the timelines for Custom Mobile Applications and Fitbit Clockface App.
- **Legal Terms Clarification:** Avicenna's SaaS terms and conditions were discussed, with potential updates due to ISO certification.
